text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: redispatcher/inference-streaming p99 latency > 3s for the last 5m. SLO impacted. Triggered paging.

alex m: seeing the same on dashboards — p95 ~1.2s -> 2.8s, p99 spikes to 4.1s. Streaming connections stalling around 10-12s for some sessions.

maria l: any deploys in the last 30m?

simon c: notable: config-service rollout started at 1803455400, but finished 12m ago. We also have a feature-flag rollout for `streaming-kv-cache-v2` started ~20m ago.

jordan p: logging shows increased latencies on config-fetch RPCs to config-db. `GET /v1/configs/*` 95th ~600ms -> 1.6s.

alex m: guess: control-plane dependency (config/auth) is adding head-of-line latency into the inference path. We call config on cold sessions to validate routing/rollouts.

rachel s: customers reporting degraded streaming (partial tokens, stalls). Support ticket #3891 from BetaCo with sample that stalled at token 42 for 18s.

eng-sre: repro logs attached. key lines:
```
2026-03-14T21:12:03Z INF request_id=abcd1234 route=streaming start
2026-03-14T21:12:03Z DBG config_fetch latency=1648ms keys=3
2026-03-14T21:12:04Z WRN stream stall after 12s kv-cache-miss
2026-03-14T21:12:05Z ERR client: downstream reset
```

maria l: quick checks I ran: config-service pods CPU ~70%, connection pool utilization to config-db at 95% and ~60 waiting conns. Postgres `max_connections` hit 480/500.

alex m: OK. action plan: 1) short-term fallback to local config cache for streaming requests, 2) increase config-db connections and scale replicas, 3) throttle non-essential feature-flag evaluation.

simon c: I can flip the local-cache fallback in the routing layer. It's an env toggle: `STREAM_CONFIG_CACHE_FALLBACK=true`. Patch and rollout in staging then prod.

jordan p: I'll request a quick DB connection increase and restart config-service pods one at a time to drain waiting conns. Also check auth rate limiter metrics.

rachel s: customer-impact: initial estimate 8% of streaming sessions show stalls >5s in the last 15m. Top affected tenants: BetaCo, Retaillytics, DocFlow. I'll open incident notify to those accounts.

incident-bot: Paging: @alex m @maria l @simon c @jordan p. Incident ticket created: INC-2026-334.

alex m: proceeding to enable fallback now. command:
```
kubectl -n runtime set env deployment/routing-service STREAM_CONFIG_CACHE_FALLBACK=true
```

maria l: scaling DB now: running `psql` and `ALTER SYSTEM SET max_connections = 800; SELECT pg_reload_conf();` then monitoring.

eng-sre: results after toggles (5m): p95 down to 0.9s, p99 down to 1.7s. Streaming stalls largely eliminated. Connection waiters disappeared.

jordan p: noticed feature-flag service has a burst queue backlog — it's doing synchronous evals on first request. I'm toggling evaluation to async for non-critical flags: `FF_ASYNC_EVAL=true` for the feature-flag-service.

rachel s: Support note: notifying BetaCo that we mitigated control-plane-induced stalls; engineering investigating root cause and will follow up.

alex m: root cause hypothesis: recent config-service rollout removed a local cache layer in some replicas; combined with a high fanout from the feature-flag rollout caused DB connection exhaustion and sync eval head-of-line blocking on streaming path.

simon c: logs to support hypothesis: many `config_fetch` stack traces with `PoolWaitTimeout` and `pg: could not get connection`. Also feature-flag RPCs show sync spikes correlated to same windows.

eng-sre: collected useful traces: `trace_id=tr-0a1b` shows streaming request spent 1.3s waiting on config-fetch, followed by a 2.6s KV cache miss.

maria l: next steps (post-mitigation):
- revert the problematic config-service change that removed local cache (PR #5123)
- add circuit-breaker on config-fetch path (timeout 300ms)
- increase DB pool and add connection quotas per replica
- change feature-flag rollout to incremental canary (reduce fanout)

jordan p: I'll queue the DB config change for off-peak window and patch the config-service restart strategy to avoid simultaneous cold-cache restarts.

alex m: handoff to next on-call @simon c at 1803457000. Summary for handoff:
- Incident: control-plane-induced streaming stalls via config-fetch and FF sync evals
- Status: mitigated (fallback + FF async + DB scale). p95/p99 recovered to SLOs.
- Action items: revert PR #5123, add circuit-breaker + observability for config-fetch latency, schedule DB pool increase + connection quotas, adjust FF rollout cadence.

simon c: I have the handoff. Will own the follow-ups and the PR revert. Re-running e2e streaming canaries now.

rachel s: I'll follow up with affected customers with timeline and RCA ETA.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-334 marked "mitigated" at 1803457110. Please update incident ticket with RCA and timelines.

alex m: nice work team. Adding tags: `root-cause: config-cache-regen`, `impact: streaming-stalls`, `mitigation: local-fallback, ff-async, db-scale`.

simon c: leaving notes in the ticket, will include query samples and psql output. Will also add a test that ensures config-server rollout preserves local-cache in future releases.

rachel s: support updated customers. Closing channel updates unless something regresses. :white_check_mark:
